onScreenText.reason: The source's sidebar, cards, tabs, search and rows are geometric placeholder bars and shapes, with no literal text to translate. Adding labels would alter the source design and landing silhouettes.

font.reason: Neutral product UI family appropriate to the mock dashboard; FaRoot loads it and sets RTL. No glyphs are currently drawn, so visual glyph verification is inapplicable.

rtlDecisions.action: Set GrayHome direction to rtl; sidebar moves to the right and the main pane starts on its left.
rtlDecisions.why: A sidebar is the first reading and navigation region in a Persian UI.

rtlDecisions.action: Use borderInlineEnd in place of the physical right border.
rtlDecisions.why: The separator belongs between the sidebar and content after the sidebar moves right.

rtlDecisions.action: Inherit rtl flex ordering; icons sit before placeholder labels at the right.
rtlDecisions.why: Navigation items follow Persian reading order.

rtlDecisions.action: Inherit rtl alignment; search icon moves to the right and the placeholder line follows it; spacing uses marginInlineStart.
rtlDecisions.why: The search affordance and entered query begin at the reading start.

rtlDecisions.what: Chip grid and each chip's two placeholder lines
rtlDecisions.action: Inherit rtl row order and right alignment while keeping the original card widths and wrapping.
rtlDecisions.why: Cards and their content should scan from right to left.

rtlDecisions.action: Inherit rtl flex order; the active tab and row bullet move to the right, with row actions on the left via marginInlineStart:auto.
rtlDecisions.why: Labels and bullets start a Persian row, while secondary actions close it.

rtlDecisions.what: Floating panel offsets and same-shape soft shadows
rtlDecisions.action: Negate only the horizontal offsets through dir(); preserve vertical heights, blur, opacity, and easing.
rtlDecisions.why: The diagonal lift should point toward the mirrored reading side without changing gravity or landing beats.

rtlDecisions.action: Mirror the SVG path start to the right midpoint; preserve trace interpolation, dash lengths, and 14-frame draw duration.
rtlDecisions.why: The frame reveal begins at the UI reading start and runs in both directions as in the source.

rtlDecisions.what: Main frame gradient, rim glow, and dim overlay
rtlDecisions.action: Reverse horizontal gradient endpoints, flip asymmetric shadow X offsets, and change CSS gradient angle from 150 to 210 degrees.
rtlDecisions.why: These asymmetries travel with the mirrored frame and maintain the same purple-to-orange balance.

rtlDecisions.action: Keep rotateY +38 to -26 degrees, rotateX, rotateZ, perspective origin 30 to 64 percent, scale and all frame timings.
rtlDecisions.why: The source prompt defines a physical left-to-right camera arc rather than a reading-order gesture.

rtlDecisions.action: Keep seeded positions, hue sequence, skew, and breathing motion.
rtlDecisions.why: They are ambient scene geometry, not an ordered UI list.

rtlDecisions.action: Keep one shared LAND=0.52, FALL=0.3 and the original easing with no stagger.
rtlDecisions.why: The source prompt requires a simultaneous whole-page arrival.

rasterHandling.action: No raster or video assets exist in this component; all visible surfaces are JSX/CSS/SVG geometry.

motionFidelity.observation: Original and localized PNGs were viewed side by side at entrance, descent, settled layout, and final camera pose. The RTL layout and mirrored trace are visible; temporal stages and physical camera pose correspond.

concerns: Because the source has no visible letters, the selected font cannot be judged for glyph shape in this card; FaRoot loads the file for future literal text.

lessons.symptom: A textless placeholder dashboard still looks LTR after a nominal Persian font change.
lessons.cause: The spatial grammar is carried by sidebar placement, icon order, cards, tabs, bullets, and the frame trace rather than glyphs.
lessons.fix: Apply RTL to the inner UI panel and logical spacing, mirror the reading-start frame trace and its light, while retaining the physical camera orbit and ambient background geometry.

concerns: No raster text, foreign on-screen text, per-character animation, or source text timing exists in this card.
lessons: For placeholder-only UI, RTL fidelity must be evaluated through geometry and motion origin even when there is no on-screen string to translate.
